posts.title: YAKKA Immersion Day 2026 | Ampcontrol
posts.copy: Recently we had the pleasure of welcoming another group of students around Ampcontrol for the YAKKA Immersion Day 2026. Sharing how we work, engaging with students and witnessing them get so involved in activities is always incredibly rewarding. This is the third consecutive year we have hosted Career Links YAKKA, and we are excited to see the program continue to grow and foster meaningful connections and opportunities for First Nations peoples. Thank you to all the students and people that made the day successful! Special thanks to Aunty Karen Karen Moran and the support of our First Nations

posts.copy: 🚚 Bound for a New South Wales coal mine, this fully overhauled 66kV mobile substation is another example of how Ampcontrol helps keep critical mining operations powered safely and reliably. posts.title: Tomago Transformer Facility Final Testing | Ampcontrol posted on the topic
posts.copy: A rare look inside our Tomago transformer facility as a 50MVA transformer is prepared for final high-voltage testing. This critical milestone represents one of the final stages in the manufacture or overhaul of a transformer, where performance, reliability, and safety are verified before the unit is released for transport to the customer's site. Beyond our workshop capabilities, Ampcontrol can perform these high-voltage transformer testing in the field using our mobile HV testing truck. See how we supported an NSW wind farm with on-site transformer testing here👉 https://lnkd.in/dvYdVKzZ #Tran
